opportunities.name: Apotheosis damage medic
opportunities.objective: Test apotheosis damage medic against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Apotheosis heals nearby allies from physical champion damage, with a documented crit-linked healing term; Ardent can reward allies healed while Visage supports Nilah's own receipt. Essence Reaver adds physical Spellblade and mana, and crit also feeds Q penetration/healing.
opportunities.requiredState: Group with attack-based allies inside R heal range.
opportunities.failure: Buying Ardent reduces personal damage and a low-damage R produces little healing.
opportunities.test: Measure ally Ardent uptime and R healing against standard crit at equal gold.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Joy Unending's amplification explicitly concerns allied champion abilities, not every item shield.

opportunities.name: Veil health-AD brawler
opportunities.objective: Test veil health-ad brawler against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Jubilant Veil dodges attacks for 2.25 seconds, creating a short melee attack opening; Titanic and Bloodmail exchange crit ceiling for health and physical attack pressure. Hexplate extends the attack phase after R while Essence Reaver preserves mana and Q's crit-linked benefits remain partial.
opportunities.requiredState: Use Veil against actual attack damage and keep Q range buff active.
opportunities.failure: Low crit reduces Q penetration/healing and spell burst bypasses the dodge.
opportunities.test: Compare health remaining and damage during Veil against physical versus spell opponents.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Attack dodge is not invulnerability and R does not freely replace lost crit scaling.

ruledOut.reason: Joy Unending's amplification explicitly concerns allied champion abilities, not every item shield.

unknowns: Proc effectiveness and ordering need a controlled current-patch test; source statFormula IDs and helper records do not establish live dispatch.

builds.name: Apotheosis damage medic
builds.summary: Test apotheosis damage medic against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test apotheosis damage medic against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Apotheosis heals nearby allies from physical champion damage, with a documented crit-linked healing term; Ardent can reward allies healed while Visage supports Nilah's own receipt. Essence Reaver adds physical Spellblade and mana, and crit also feeds Q penetration/healing.
testPlan: Required state: Group with attack-based allies inside R heal range.
Measure ally Ardent uptime and R healing against standard crit at equal gold.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Buying Ardent reduces personal damage and a low-damage R produces little healing.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Joy Unending's amplification explicitly concerns allied champion abilities, not every item shield.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Essence Reaver, Infinity Edge, Bloodthirster, Spirit Visage, Ardent Censer, Mercury's Treads. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula:
Passive: Nilah gains [(0.3) × Stat(8)] Armor Penetration, and her Attacks against champions restore [(0.2) × Stat(8)] damage dealt as Health. Overhealing from this is converted into a Shield for [4] seconds.

Active: Nilah cracks her whip-blade, dealing [(0 / 10 / 20 / 30 / 40 + (1) × AD) × ((1 + ((0.7) × Stat(8)) × (((1) × Stat(9) + -1))))] physical damage. If an enemy unit or structure is hit, Nilah gains 125 Attack Range and [characterLevelInterpolation(10 → 60; raw flags preserved)]% Attack Speed, and her Attacks hit in a cone for [4] seconds.

Nilah envelops herself in mist for [2.25] seconds, becoming Ghosted, gaining [(0.15 / 0.175 / 0.2 / 0.225 / 0.25) × 100]% Move Speed, dodging Attacks, and reducing magic damage taken by [25]%.

While active, touching allied champions envelops them in mist, granting the same benefits for [1.5] seconds.

When Nilah kills a minion, she and her nearest ally gain [50]% of the experience they would have normally lost from sharing the kill.

Nilah gains [7.5]% increased effectiveness from healing and [15]% from shielding given to her by allied champions abilities. If an ally heals or shields her, they will also gain the increased amount of the shield or heal themselves. If an ally shields or heals themself, Nilah will also gain that additional effect.

Nilah whirls her whip-blade, dealing [(15 / 25 / 35 + (0.1) × AD[statFormula=2]) × (4)] physical damage over 1 second, then finishes with a burst of [125 / 225 / 325 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage that also Pulls nearby enemies toward her.

Apotheosis heals Nilah and her nearby allies for [0.2 + (0.1) × Stat(8)] (+@spell.NilahQ:CritLifesteal@ {{ Spell_NilahQ_Name }}) of the damage dealt to enemy champions, converting any overhealing into a Shield for [6] seconds.
